note: configs/confirmation_protocol.json is the frozen pre-registration and is deliberately left unedited. This file records what the code actually executes, so the divergence is machine-readable rather than something a reader must infer by reading evaluation.py.
primary_gate_definition: No comparator significantly exceeds the primary method in any evaluated modality, by exact subject-cluster sign-flip test with Holm correction inside that modality's comparator family.
primary_gate_is_not_equivalence: Absence of a significant loss is the claim. The study is not powered as an equivalence trial and no equivalence bound is declared.
reference_alias_note: MajorityVote is the historical name of the same rule and is emitted alongside it. It is excluded from every comparator family; leaving it in compared the primary method against itself and inflated each Holm family by one.
primary_multiplicity: Holm within each modality comparator family, not across modalities
multiplicity_change_note: The frozen protocol declared Holm across WGS, WES and RNA-seq for a three-modality primary endpoint. With a per-modality comparator family the correction is applied within each modality. This is a change in the correction structure and is disclosed, not presented as prespecified.
per_gene_harm_gate: The primary method must not significantly harm any single gene relative to the abstaining two-thirds baseline.
per_gene_harm_anchor_note: Previously anchored on TwoThirdsGuardedCC, which is no longer the primary method. The guarded per-gene test is retained as an ablation record under guarded_cc_per_gene_harm.
absent_comparator_scoring: A comparator with no row at an eligible locus is scored incorrect there, so every method shares one denominator. Per-comparator coverage is reported beside each comparison.
manuscript_modalities_note: WGS is excluded from the reported scope because its legacy inputs are invalid. It appears only as a diagnostic. The evaluation artifact records modalities_evaluated so the scope of any run is auditable.
bootstrap_seeding: per (modality, comparator); seeding per modality alone made every comparator in a modality resample on an identical sequence, so their intervals were perfectly correlated
interval_versus_test_precedence: Where a bootstrap interval excludes zero but the Holm-adjusted exact test does not reach significance, the Holm-adjusted test governs the claim.
imgt_hla_version_note: The single value 3.59.0 in configs/runtime_versions.json describes the project reference resources, not the callers. Each caller bundles its own IPD-IMGT/HLA release, spanning 3.11.0 to 3.63.0. See artifacts/db_release_resolution/db_release_resolution.json and the Methods table.
claim_boundary: Equal-weight consensus matches the modality-best caller without prior caller selection, and is not exceeded by any tested integration method in WES or RNA-seq.
